observable.orientation_coordinate: P4 angular-normalized first-minus-second contrast at the source intrinsic center

selection.rule: use the source artifact's predeclared high_statistics_summary sizes and exclude only the two P154 10M variance pilots

confidence.construction: two-sided Gaussian Bonferroni intervals across the eight selected production datasets
confidence.covariance: same-dataset intrinsic-center first-order A_top/E_top covariance from aligned production batches
confidence.cross_dataset_rule: no cross-dataset independence or pooled p-value is used; one incompatible simultaneous interval eliminates a universal fixed-ratio model

fixed_ratio_models.meaning: pure Alexander-odd state response with E_top=0

free_ratio_model.meaning: one geometry-independent mixing line E_top=r*A_top with free real r
free_ratio_model.certificate: intersection of simultaneous Fieller sets; an empty intersection eliminates the model

claim_boundary: This is a machine-checkable certificate relative to the declared Gaussian first-order outer confidence sets. It is not an exact finite-replica theorem, a continuum field identity, an exponent fit, or an independence-weighted meta-analysis.
